clips.title: The story
paras: In the Wetlands, giant crocolisks yield thick hides that Menethil Harbor tradesmen need for leatherworking. Taking one is perilous work, and more than one hunter has been maimed.

The Wetlands' bogs and waterways shelter enormous crocolisks with hides dense enough to resist the marsh's damp rot. In Menethil Harbor, artisans such as James Halloran rely on steady shipments of skins to make rugged leather goods. Reaching a full-grown giant crocolisk means braving deep water and facing a fierce swamp predator, so every hide comes hard-won.
